```{r GT_extraction, echo=FALSE}

# Read in vcf and create unique loci IDs "CHROM:POS"
vcf <- read.vcfR("./hostprefQTL-QuinqsT.filtered-variants.vcf.recode.vcf")
locus_ids <- paste(
  vcf@fix[,"CHROM"],
  vcf@fix[,"POS"],
  sep = ":"
)

# Extract just GT strings and change to pseudo allele counts
gt <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "GT")

gt_num <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=nrow(gt), ncol=ncol(gt))

gt_num[gt == "0/0"] <- 0
gt_num[gt %in% c("0/1", "1/0")] <- 1
gt_num[gt == "1/1"] <- 2

# Transform to row = individuals, cols = loci
geno_mat <- t(gt_num)

# Name rows and cols correctly
colnames(geno_mat) <- locus_ids
rownames(geno_mat) <- colnames(gt)

geno_df <- data.frame(
  geno_mat,
  check.names = FALSE
)

```

```{r PCA-on-LD-pruned-SNPs, echo=FALSE}

# Read in the LD pruned data (~7000 SNPs instead of ~26,000) -- from bash script "LD_prune.sh"
geno_raw <- read.table("hostpref_PCA_ready.raw", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Clean data and keep only genotypes (first 6 columns are PLINK metadata (FID, IID, PAT, MAT, SEX, PHENOTYPE)
geno_data <- geno_raw[, -(1:6)]

# Set row names to the individual IDs (IID is usually column 2)
rownames(geno_data) <- geno_raw[, 2]

# Now that missing values are filled in, remove F0s and F1s
keep <- str_count(rownames(geno_data), "-") >= 3
geno_data <- geno_data[keep, ]

# Handle Missing Data (NA) -- though we did not retain any SNPs with >20% missingness,
# vegan's rda() will fail if there are ANY NAs.
# So any remaining NAs were replace with the mean genotype at that position.

geno_imputed <- apply(geno_data, 2, function(x) {
  x[is.na(x)] <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  return(x)
})

# Check that row orders for genotype and phenotype matrices match!
common_ids <- intersect(rownames(geno_imputed), rownames(metadata_sub))
geno_matrix <- geno_imputed[common_ids, ]

pheno_df <- metadata_sub[common_ids, ] # renamed metadata_sub to pheno_df

# PCA on ancestry, note that scale=TRUE here.
pca_ancestry <- rda(geno_imputed, scale = TRUE)

# Grab eigenvals and calculate % variation for each PC and create labels
eig <- eigenvals(pca_ancestry)
var_explained <- eig / sum(eig) * 100

pc1_lab <- paste0("PC1 (", round(var_explained[1], 1), "%)")
pc2_lab <- paste0("PC2 (", round(var_explained[2], 1), "%)")


# Extract PCs for plotting
conditioning_vars <- scores(pca_ancestry, choices = c(1, 2), display = "sites")

# Visualization
pca_plot_df <- data.frame(conditioning_vars, Group = pheno_df$Group, Response = pheno_df$Response, Family = pheno_df$Family.lvl1)

p <- ggplot(pca_plot_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Family, shape = Response)) + 
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 4)) +
  labs(x = pc1_lab, 
       y = pc2_lab) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
        plot.margin = unit(c(3, 1, 1, 1), "lines"),
        legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

#ggsave("PCA_LD-pruned_SNPs.png", plot=p, dpi = 500)

```

```{r partial_RDA, echo=FALSE}

# Now we return to the full set of SNPs, all ~26,000, for the RDA...

#Remove F0s and F1s.
keep <- str_count(rownames(geno_df), "-") >= 3
geno_matrix <- geno_df[keep, ]

# Again, RDA can't handle missing values. So impute average based on ALL sequenced individuals (F0s, F1s, F2s, and back-crosses.)
geno_matrix[] <- lapply(geno_matrix, function(x) {
  x[is.na(x)] <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x
})

# Make sure row orders match in both matrices
common_ids <- intersect(rownames(geno_matrix), rownames(metadata_sub))
geno_matrix <- geno_matrix[common_ids, ]
pheno_df <- metadata_sub[common_ids, ]  # renamed metadata_sub to pheno_df

# ==============================================================================
# PARTIAL RDA
# ==============================================================================
# Model: Genotype ~ Phenotype + Family
# Use the categorical Phenotype (h,s,c) as the predictor.

Y <- geno_matrix                        # Response ("geno_matrix" is full set ~26,000 SNPs)
X <- pheno_df$Response                  # Predictor
Z <- pheno_df$Family.lvl1               # Condition

# Run Partial RDA
# scale=FALSE ensures emphasis on common/strongly segregating SNPs, sensible for QTL
# scale=TRUE would give equal weight to rare alleles, which may not clearly segregate with host choice and just come from a random parent
rda_model <- rda(Y ~ X + Condition(Z), scale = FALSE)

# Summary of variance explained
print(summary(rda_model))

# Significance Test (Permutation Test)
anova_result <- anova.cca(rda_model, permutations = 1000, parallel = 4)
print(anova_result)

# Extract eigenvalues, calculate total and constrained variance explained by each axis 
eig <- eigenvals(rda_model)
var_perc <- round((eig / rda_model$tot.chi) * 100, 1) #total variance
constrained_perc <- round((eig / rda_model$CCA$tot.chi) * 100, 1) #constrained variance

# Extract the scores for sites (mosquitoes) and centroids (phenotypes)
# scaling = 3 is symmetric scaling
sites_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_model, display = "sites", scaling = 3))
centroid_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_model, display = "cn", scaling = 3))
centroid_scores$label <- rownames(centroid_scores)

# Bind the host choice column to the extracted scores dataframe.
# Make sure the row order of 'sites_scores' matches yothe ur original dataset!
sites_scores$Host_Pref <- metadata_sub$Response

# Plot
p <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = sites_scores, aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, shape = Host_Pref), 
             color = "grey60", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("c" = 16, "h" = 17, "s" = 4)) +
  geom_text_repel(data = centroid_scores, aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = label), 
                  color = "blue", size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_point(data = centroid_scores, aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2), 
             color = "blue", shape = 17, size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Partial RDA: Genotypes ~ Host Pref | Family",
       x = paste0("RDA 1: ", var_perc["RDA1"], "% [", constrained_perc["RDA1"], "%]"),
       y = paste0("RDA 2: ", var_perc["RDA2"], "% [", constrained_perc["RDA2"], "%]"))

#ggsave("partialRDA_plot.png", plot=p, dpi = 500)

```

```{r gene_lists}

# Generate clean table of all annotated genes in Cx. quinquefasciatus

gff <- read.table("../../manuscript/FINAL_SUBMISSION/SUPPLEMENTARY DATA/S1_merged_chemosensory-genes_JHB2020v68.gff3",
                  sep = "\t",
                  comment.char = "#",
                  quote = "",
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

colnames(gff) <- c("seqid", "source", "type",
                   "start", "end", "score",
                   "strand", "phase", "attributes")

genes <- subset(gff, type == "gene")
genes$gene_id <- sub(".*ID=([^;]+).*", "\\1", genes$attributes)
genes$gene_name <- sub(".*locus=([^;]+).*", "\\1", genes$attributes)
genes$gene_description <- sub(".*description=([^;]+).*", "\\1", genes$attributes)

# Now subsect by chemosensory gene families
ORs <- genes[grepl("^(Or)", genes$gene_name),]
OBPs <- genes[grepl("^(Obp)", genes$gene_name),]
GRs <- genes[grepl("^(Gr)", genes$gene_name),]
IRs <- genes[grepl("^(Ir)", genes$gene_name),]
chemo_genes <- genes[grepl("^(Or|Obp|Gr|Ir)", genes$gene_name),]

```

```{r extract_RDA1_coordinates, echo=FALSE}
# Convert to data frame
snp_df <- as.data.frame(snp_scores)

# Add SNP ID from rownames
snp_df$SNP <- rownames(snp_df)

# Rank by absolute RDA1 loading
top1_snps <- snp_df |>
  transform(absRDA1 = abs(RDA1)) |>
  subset(absRDA1 >= quantile(absRDA1, 0.95)) # Top 5% of SNPs

coords <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(top1_snps$SNP, ":"))

top1_snps$CHROM <- coords[, 1]
top1_snps$POS   <- as.integer(coords[, 2])

window <- 171400/2 # 171400 Determined by LD decay analysis on chromosome 3 

hits1 <- merge(top1_snps, genes,
              by.x = "CHROM",
              by.y = "seqid")

nearby_genes1 <- subset(
  hits1,
  abs(POS - start) <= window |
  abs(POS - end)   <= window |
  (POS >= start - window & POS <= end + window)
)

final_hits1 <- nearby_genes1[, c(
  "CHROM", "POS", "RDA1", "gene_id",
  "gene_name", "gene_description", "start", "end", "strand"
)]
final_hits1 <- final_hits1 %>%
  mutate(CHROM = recode(CHROM, 
                      "CM027410.1" = "chromosome 1", 
                      "CM027411.1" = "chromosome 2", 
                      "CM027412.1" = "chromosome 3"))

filtered_hits1 <- final_hits1 %>%
  # Sort by gene id, then by the highest effect score
  arrange(gene_id, desc(abs(RDA1))) %>% 
  # Distinct will keep the version of the gene with the highest RDA score
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  # Re-sort by genomic position for final table
  arrange(parse_number(CHROM), start)

candidate_genes1 <- filtered_hits1[
  grepl("^(Or|Obp|Ir|Gr)", filtered_hits1$gene_name),
]

#write.table(filtered_hits1, file="RDA1_top5%_SNPs_all_genes.txt", quote=FALSE, sep="\t")
#write.table(candidate_genes1, file="RDA1_top5%_SNPs_chemosensory_genes.txt", quote=FALSE, sep="\t")
```

```{r extract_RDA2_coordinates, echo=FALSE}
# Convert to data frame
snp_df <- as.data.frame(snp_scores)

# Add SNP ID from rownames
snp_df$SNP <- rownames(snp_df)

# Rank by absolute RDA2 loading
top2_snps <- snp_df |>
  transform(absRDA2 = abs(RDA2)) |>
  subset(absRDA2 >= quantile(absRDA2, 0.95))

coords <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(top2_snps$SNP, ":"))

top2_snps$CHROM <- coords[, 1]
top2_snps$POS   <- as.integer(coords[, 2])

window <- 171400/2 # 171400 Determined by LD decay analysis on chromosome 3

hits2 <- merge(top2_snps, genes,
              by.x = "CHROM",
              by.y = "seqid")

nearby_genes2 <- subset(
  hits2,
  abs(POS - start) <= window |
  abs(POS - end)   <= window |
  (POS >= start - window & POS <= end + window)
)

final_hits2 <- nearby_genes2[, c(
  "CHROM", "POS", "RDA2", "gene_id",
  "gene_name", "gene_description", "start", "end", "strand"
)]
final_hits2 <- final_hits2 %>%
  mutate(CHROM = recode(CHROM, 
                      "CM027410.1" = "chromosome 1", 
                      "CM027411.1" = "chromosome 2", 
                      "CM027412.1" = "chromosome 3"))

filtered_hits2 <- final_hits2 %>%
  # Sort by gene id, then by the highest effect score
  arrange(gene_id, desc(abs(RDA2))) %>% 
  # Distinct will keep the version of the gene with the highest RDA score
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  # R-sort by genomic position for your final table
  arrange(parse_number(CHROM), start)

candidate_genes2 <- filtered_hits2[
  grepl("^(Or|Obp|Ir|Gr)", filtered_hits2$gene_name),
]
```

``` {r, compare_hets, echo=FALSE}
 # ==============================================================================
# Plot Genotype Percentages for Top RDA1 SNPs (comparing heterozygosity)
# ==============================================================================

# Subset the genotype matrix to only include the top 5% RDA1 SNPs
geno_subset <- geno_matrix[, top2_snps$SNP]

# Combine with phenotypes and convert to a data frame
plot_df <- as.data.frame(geno_subset)
plot_df$Sample <- rownames(plot_df)
plot_df$Response <- pheno_df$Response

# Reshape and Calculate Percentages
counts_melted <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Sample, Response), 
    names_to = "SNP", 
    values_to = "Genotype"
  ) %>%
  # Filter out the imputed decimal values
  filter(Genotype %in% c(0, 1, 2)) %>%
  # Convert to factor early so all 3 categories can be tracked (0, 1, 2)
  mutate(Genotype = factor(Genotype, levels = c(0, 1, 2))) %>%
  # Group to count occurrences per sample
  group_by(Sample, Response, Genotype) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  # Ensure samples with 0 of a specific genotype are explicitly counted as 0
  tidyr::complete(Genotype, fill = list(Count = 0)) %>%
  # Calculate percentage: (Genotype Count / Total Valid SNPs for that Sample) * 100
  mutate(Percentage = (Count / sum(Count)) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot
ggplot(counts_melted, aes(x = Genotype, y = Percentage, fill = Response)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = 1,  
    outlier.size = 2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("c" = "#3274A1", "h" = "#E1812C", "s" = "#3A923A")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Genotype Percentages by Response Category (Top RDA2 SNPs)",
    x = "Genotype (0 = Hom Ref, 1 = Het, 2 = Hom Alt)",
    y = "Percentage of Individual's SNPs (%)"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r plot_RDA_SNPs}

# Bold genes that are present in both RDA1 and RDA2 sets
shared_set <- merged_chemo_genes %>% filter(!is.na(merged_chemo_genes$RDA1)&!is.na(merged_chemo_genes$RDA2))
unique_set <- merged_chemo_genes %>% filter(!is.na(merged_chemo_genes$RDA1)&is.na(merged_chemo_genes$RDA2))

# Group genes that are within 200kb of each other -- arbitrary, just for visualization purposes

clustered_uniq_labels <- unique_set %>%
  arrange(CHROM, start) %>%
  group_by(CHROM) %>%
  mutate(group = cumsum(c(1, diff(start) > 200000))) %>% # 100kb threshold
  group_by(CHROM, group) %>%
  summarize(
    # Collapse all gene names in the cluster into one vertical string
    label_stack = paste(gene_name, collapse = "\n"),
    # Point the segment to the average or peak position
    POS = mean(as.numeric(start)),
    RDA1 = max(RDA1),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

clustered_shared_labels <- shared_set %>%
  arrange(CHROM, start) %>%
  group_by(CHROM) %>%
  mutate(group = cumsum(c(1, diff(start) > 200000))) %>% # 100kb threshold
  group_by(CHROM, group) %>%
  summarize(
    # Collapse all gene names in the cluster into one vertical string
    label_stack = paste(gene_name, collapse = "\n"),
    # Point the segment to the average or peak position
    POS = mean(as.numeric(start)),
    RDA1 = max(RDA1),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )



snp_df <- as.data.frame(snp_scores)
coords <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(as.character(rownames(snp_df)), ":"))
snp_df$CHROM <- coords[, 1]
snp_df$POS   <- as.integer(coords[, 2])

snp_df <- snp_df %>%
  mutate(CHROM = recode(CHROM, 
                      "CM027410.1" = "chromosome 1", 
                      "CM027411.1" = "chromosome 2", 
                      "CM027412.1" = "chromosome 3"))
snp_df <- snp_df %>% filter(snp_df$CHROM != "NC_014574.1")

y_limit_upper <- 1.5
y_limit_lower <- -1.5

# Define stronger repulsion variables
h_force <- 20   # Increase from default (1) to push labels apart horizontally
pull_strength <- 0.1 # Decrease from default (1) so they don't 'cling' to the point too much

# ---------------------------------------
# plot for Rda1
# ---------------------------------------

snp_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = RDA1, x = as.numeric(POS), color = as.factor(CHROM))) + 
  geom_point(cex = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = snp_df %>% slice_max(abs(RDA1), prop = 0.05),
             aes(y = RDA1, x = as.numeric(POS)), cex = 0.5, color= "red") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = rep(c("grey15", "grey65"), times = 3)) + 

  # POSITIVE LABELS (Top) - Combined Uniq & Shared for better dodging
  geom_text_repel(data = rbind(subset(clustered_uniq_labels, RDA1 > 0),
                               subset(clustered_shared_labels, RDA1 > 0)),  
                  aes(x = POS, y = RDA1, label = label_stack, 
                      fontface = ifelse(label_stack %in% clustered_shared_labels$label_stack, "bold.italic", "plain")), 
                  size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.8, color = "grey30", segment.color = "grey75",
                  
                  nudge_y = 0.8,
                  direction = "both",
                  ylim = c(0.2, y_limit_upper),
                  force = h_force,
                  force_pull = pull_strength,
                  box.padding = 0.5,
                  point.padding = 0.3,
                  
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = 0.3,
                  max.overlaps = Inf) +

  # NEGATIVE LABELS (Bottom) - Combined Uniq & Shared
  geom_text_repel(data = rbind(subset(clustered_uniq_labels, RDA1 < 0),
                               subset(clustered_shared_labels, RDA1 < 0)),  
                  aes(x = POS, y = RDA1, label = label_stack,
                      fontface = ifelse(label_stack %in% clustered_shared_labels$label_stack, "bold.italic", "plain")), 
                  size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.8, color = "grey30", segment.color = "grey75",
                  
                  nudge_y = -0.8,
                  direction = "both",
                  ylim = c(y_limit_lower, -0.2),
                  force = h_force,
                  force_pull = pull_strength,
                  box.padding = 0.5,
                  point.padding = 0.3,
                  
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = 0.3,
                  max.overlaps = Inf) +

  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_limit_lower, y_limit_upper)) +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~CHROM, nrow = 1, strip.position="bottom", scales = "free_x") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"), 
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_blank())

```

```{r}
  )

clustered_shared_labels <- shared_set %>%
  arrange(CHROM, start) %>%
  group_by(CHROM) %>%
  mutate(group = cumsum(c(1, diff(start) > 200000))) %>%
  group_by(CHROM, group) %>%
  summarize(
    label_stack = paste(gene_name, collapse = "\n"),
    POS = mean(as.numeric(start)),
    RDA2 = max(RDA2),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

snp_df <- as.data.frame(snp_scores)
coords <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(as.character(rownames(snp_df)), ":"))
snp_df$CHROM <- coords[, 1]
snp_df$POS   <- as.integer(coords[, 2])

snp_df <- snp_df %>%
  mutate(CHROM = recode(CHROM, 
                      "CM027410.1" = "chromosome 1", 
                      "CM027411.1" = "chromosome 2", 
                      "CM027412.1" = "chromosome 3"))
snp_df <- snp_df %>% filter(snp_df$CHROM != "NC_014574.1")

y_limit_upper <- 1.5
y_limit_lower <- -1.5

h_force <- 20
pull_strength <- 0.1

# ------------------------------------
# plot for Rda2
# ------------------------------------

snp_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = RDA2, x = as.numeric(POS), color = as.factor(CHROM))) + 
  geom_point(cex = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = snp_df %>% slice_max(abs(RDA2), prop = 0.05),
             aes(y = RDA2, x = as.numeric(POS)), cex = 0.5, color= "red") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = rep(c("grey15", "grey65"), times = 3)) + 

  # POSITIVE LABELS (Top) - Combined Uniq & Shared for better dodging
  geom_text_repel(data = rbind(subset(clustered_uniq_labels, RDA2 > 0),
                               subset(clustered_shared_labels, RDA2 > 0)),  
                  aes(x = POS, y = RDA2, label = label_stack, 
                      fontface = ifelse(label_stack %in% clustered_shared_labels$label_stack, "bold.italic", "plain")), 
                  size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.8, color = "grey30", segment.color = "grey75",
                  
                  nudge_y = 0.8,
                  direction = "both",
                  ylim = c(0.2, y_limit_upper),
                  force = h_force,
                  force_pull = pull_strength,
                  box.padding = 0.5,
                  point.padding = 0.3,
                  
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = 0.3,
                  max.overlaps = Inf) +

  # NEGATIVE LABELS (Bottom) - Combined Uniq & Shared
  geom_text_repel(data = rbind(subset(clustered_uniq_labels, RDA2 < 0),
                               subset(clustered_shared_labels, RDA2 < 0)),  
                  aes(x = POS, y = RDA2, label = label_stack,
                      fontface = ifelse(label_stack %in% clustered_shared_labels$label_stack, "bold.italic", "plain")), 
                  size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.8, color = "grey30", segment.color = "grey75",
                  
                  nudge_y = -0.8,
                  direction = "both",
                  ylim = c(y_limit_lower, -0.2),
                  force = h_force,
                  force_pull = pull_strength,
                  box.padding = 0.5,
                  point.padding = 0.3,
                  
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = 0.3,
                  max.overlaps = Inf) +

  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_limit_lower, y_limit_upper)) +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~CHROM, nrow = 1, strip.position="bottom", scales = "free_x") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"), 
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_blank())
```

```{r, extract_gene_ranges}
ORs_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = as.character(ORs$seqid), 
                  ranges = IRanges(start = ORs$start, end = ORs$end))

OBPs_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = as.character(OBPs$seqid), 
                  ranges = IRanges(start = OBPs$start, end = OBPs$end))

IRs_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = as.character(IRs$seqid), 
                  ranges = IRanges(start = IRs$start, end = IRs$end))

GRs_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = as.character(GRs$seqid), 
                  ranges = IRanges(start = GRs$start, end = GRs$end))

# All chemosensory and all gene GRanges
chemo_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = as.character(chemo_genes$seqid), 
                  ranges = IRanges(start = chemo_genes$start, end = chemo_genes$end))

all_genes_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = as.character(genes$seqid), 
                        ranges = IRanges(start = genes$start, end = genes$end))

# Top RDA1 SNPs GRanges
top1_snps_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = top1_snps$CHROM, 
                        ranges = IRanges(start = top1_snps$POS, end = top1_snps$POS))

# Top RDA2 SNPs GRanges
top2_snps_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = as.character(top2_snps$CHROM), 
                        ranges = IRanges(start = top2_snps$POS, end = top2_snps$POS))
```

```{r}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RDA1 (host fidelity) ANALYSIS: ALL CHEMOSENSORY GENES
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- OBSERVED PROPORTION ---
# Get unique OR genes within 171.4kb
obs_chemo_hits <- subsetByOverlaps(chemo_gr, top1_snps_gr + (171400/2))
# Get unique TOTAL genes within 171.4kb
obs_total_hits <- subsetByOverlaps(all_genes_gr, top1_snps_gr + (171400/2))

# Calculate Observed Proportion
observed_prop <- length(unique(obs_chemo_hits)) / length(unique(obs_total_hits))

# --- PERMUTATION LOOP ---
all_snp_names <- colnames(geno_df)[-1] 
n_permutations <- 1000
null_props <- numeric(n_permutations)
n_top1_snps <- nrow(top1_snps)

for(i in 1:n_permutations) {
  # Sample random SNPs
  random_snp_subset <- sample(all_snp_names, n_top1_snps)
  
  # Extract coordinates
  random_snps_info <- data.frame(snp_id = random_snp_subset) %>%
    separate(snp_id, into = c("chr", "pos"), sep = ":", convert = TRUE)
  
  # Convert to GRanges
  random_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = as.character(random_snps_info$chr), 
                       ranges = IRanges(start = random_snps_info$pos, 
                                        end = random_snps_info$pos))
  
  # Calculate Proportion for this random set
  # Count unique ORs
  rand_chemo_hits <- subsetByOverlaps(chemo_gr, random_gr + (171400/2))
  # Count unique TOTAL genes
  rand_total_hits <- subsetByOverlaps(all_genes_gr, random_gr + (171400/2))
  
  # Store the proportion
  total_count <- length(unique(rand_total_hits))
  if(total_count > 0){
    null_props[i] <- length(unique(rand_chemo_hits)) / total_count
  } else {
    null_props[i] <- 0
  }
}

# --- STATS & PLOTTING ---
p_value <- (sum(null_props <= observed_prop)) / (n_permutations)

hist(null_props, main="Permutation Test: Proportion of Chemosensory Genes (RDA1)", 
     xlab="Proportion (Chemosensory / Total Genes)", 
     col="lightgrey", border="white")
abline(v = observed_prop, col="red", lwd=2, lty=2)

```
